repairs.after: Moreover flood and drought are misfortunes Yao and Tang did not escape; a king ought to dredge and maintain canals and ditches, following the Zheng and Bai canals and the irrigation methods of Ximen and Shi Qi; in drought open ditches as rain, in flood send water into channels; above no worry like the "Yunhan," below no trouble of mire and flood.

repairs.before: Huang issued an edict: “Feng Yu’s words frighten me.
repairs.after: Huang then issued an order, saying: “On reading the remonstrance of Recorder Feng, I am truly afraid.
repairs.sourceQuote: 皝乃令曰：「覽封記室之諫，孤實懼焉。
repairs.reason: English drops 乃令曰, 覽, and the title 封記室, reducing them to “Feng Yu’s words.”

repairs.before: The heartland is still at war, so I cannot yet cut official posts.
repairs.after: The heartland is not yet pacified, warfare does not cease, and many have rendered meritorious and loyal service, so the official establishment cannot be reduced.
repairs.sourceQuote: 中州未平，兵難不息，勳誠既多，官僚不可以減也。
repairs.reason: Omits 勳誠既多 and softens 官僚不可以減也. Host retains both meritorious and loyal service in 勳誠.

repairs.before: Ministers who speak truth deserve patience—ignore wild rumors but heed good counsel.
repairs.after: For a minister to offer words that touch his ruler is most difficult; wild and baseless matters should all be brushed aside without inquiry, while one chooses what is good and follows it.
repairs.sourceQuote: 夫人臣關言於人主，至難也，妖妄不經之事皆應蕩然不問，擇其善者而從之。
repairs.reason: Paraphrase omits 關言於人主，至難也 and the full 妖妄…擇其善者而從之 structure.

repairs.before: As for minister’s presenting words to the lord sovereign—most difficult; demonic and wild not-classic matters all ought to be swept away unasked; choose the good of them and follow them.
repairs.after: For a minister to present words to his sovereign is most difficult; absurd and unfounded matters should all be set aside without inquiry, while he chooses what is good and follows it.
repairs.sourceQuote: 夫人臣關言於人主，至難也，妖妄不經之事皆應蕩然不問，擇其善者而從之。
repairs.reason: Host replaces the misleading literal not-classic/demonic wording for 妖妄不經 while preserving the complete counsel structure.

repairs.before: Restore censured advisers to their posts.
repairs.after: They may all be restored to their original offices and still serve in the remonstrance bureau.
repairs.reason: Omits 悉, 本官, and 仍居諫司.

repairs.before: Award him fifty thousand cash and invite anyone, high or low, to criticize me freely.”
repairs.after: So award him fifty thousand cash, and clearly announce inside and outside that whoever wishes to state my faults, whether noble or base, need have no taboo.”
repairs.sourceQuote: '其賜錢五萬，明宣內外，有欲陳孤過者，不拘貴賤，勿有所諱。」
repairs.reason: Omits 明宣內外 and flattens 有欲陳孤過者，不拘貴賤，勿有所諱.

repairs.after: Murong Ke attacked Goguryeo’s Nansu, took it, posted a garrison, and returned.
repairs.sourceQuote: 慕容恪攻高句麗南蘇，克之，置戍而還。
repairs.reason: Omits 而還 and the attack verb 攻.

repairs.before: In his third regnal year he sent Murong Jun and Murong Ke with seventeen thousand horse against Puyu; they captured the king and fifty thousand subjects.
repairs.after: In the third year he sent his heir Jun and Ke with seventeen thousand cavalry to raid Puyu eastward; they took it, captured its king and more than fifty thousand of the tribe, and returned.
repairs.sourceQuote: 三年，遣其世子俊與恪率騎萬七千東襲夫餘，克之，虜其王及部眾五萬餘口以還。
repairs.reason: “His third regnal year” over-reads bare 三年; omits 東襲, 餘, and 以還.

repairs.reason: The existing English omits the oath (常克心自誓，志吞醜虜) and the whole clause 下謝山海之責, and it renders 先王遺旨 loosely. The replacement covers every clause. Use it for each repeated use of this unit's English.

repairs.before: But the rebellious Hu stride occupying the divine continent; the central plain is not yet quieted; Han constantly set heart to swear, intent to swallow the ugly bandits, above to complete the late king’s leftover command, below to apologize for the duty to mountains and seas.

repairs.sourceQuote: 但逆胡跨據神州，中原未靖，翰常克心自誓，志吞醜虜，上成先王遺旨，下謝山海之責。
repairs.reason: Host paired-field repair: 下謝山海之責 discharges an obligation; the current literal apologize for the duty is misleading. Preserve the oath, aim, final instructions and obligation.

context.zh: 跡其所由，實因故司空亮居元舅之尊，勢業之重，執政裁下，輕侮邊將，故令蘇峻、祖約不勝其忿，遂致敗國。
context.literal: Tracing where it came from, it was truly because the late Minister of Works Yu Liang occupied the honor of chief maternal uncle and the weight of power and achievement, governed and judged subordinates, and lightly insulted frontier generals, so that Su Jun and Zu Yue could not contain their rage and thus brought disaster on the state.
context.idiomatic: The root cause was the late Minister of Works Yu Liang: as chief maternal uncle he wielded overwhelming power, judged subordinates harshly, and insulted frontier generals until Su Jun and Zu Yue, unable to bear their rage, ruined the state.

context.zh: 至今太后發憤，一旦升遐。
context.literal: Until now the Empress Dowager gave vent to her indignation and in one morning ascended to distant heaven.
context.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager has died in indignation.

context.zh: 若社稷不靈，人神無助，豺狼之心當可極邪！
context.literal: If the altars were not numinous and men and spirits gave no aid, would the heart of wolves and jackals be allowed to reach its limit!
context.idiomatic: Had the altars not been numinous and heaven not aided us, would the hearts of wolves and jackals have been allowed to run their course!

context.zh: 自永嘉喪亂，百姓流亡，中原蕭條，千里無煙，饑寒流隕，相繼溝壑。
context.literal: Since the Yongjia calamity the people have fled; the central plain is desolate, for a thousand li no smoke rises; hunger and cold flow in ruin and men fall one after another into ditches and gullies.
context.idiomatic: Since the Yongjia calamity the people have fled; the central plain is desolate and hunger fills the ditches.

context.zh: 先王以神武聖略，保全一方，威以殄奸，德以懷遠，故九州之人，塞表殊類，繈負萬里，若赤子之歸慈父，流人之多舊土十倍有餘，人殷地狹，故無田者十有四焉。
context.literal: The former king, by divine martial sage strategy, preserved one region; by might he destroyed traitors and by virtue he won the distant; therefore people of the nine provinces and foreign tribes beyond the frontier came carrying infants for ten thousand li, like infants returning to a loving father; the displaced exceeded the old population more than tenfold, the people were many and the land narrow, so those without fields were fourteen in ten.
context.idiomatic: Murong Hui, by divine martial strategy, preserved this region, destroyed traitors by might and won the distant by virtue; people of the nine provinces and foreign tribes came carrying infants for ten thousand li like children to a loving father. Refugees outnumbered the old population more than tenfold; land was scarce and fourteen in ten had no fields.

context.zh: 殿下以英聖之資，克廣先業，南摧強趙，東滅句麗，開境三千，戶增十萬，繼武闡廣之功，有高西伯。
context.literal: Your Highness, with heroic and sage endowment, has been able to extend the former enterprise: south you crushed strong Zhao, east you destroyed Goguryeo, opened three thousand li of border and increased households by a hundred thousand, continuing the merit of martial expansion, rivaling the great Earl of the West.
context.idiomatic: Your Highness, with heroic endowment, has extended the former enterprise: south you crushed strong Zhao, east you destroyed Goguryeo, opened three thousand li and added a hundred thousand households, rivaling the great Earl of the West.

context.zh: 臣猶曰非明王之道，而況增乎！
context.literal: Your servant still says this is not the way of a clear king, and how much more if it is increased!
context.idiomatic: I still say this is not the way of a clear king, and how much more if burdens increase!

context.zh: 且水旱之厄，堯、湯所不免，王者宜浚治溝澮，循鄭白、西門、史起溉灌之法，旱則決溝為雨，水則入於溝瀆，上無《雲漢》之憂，下無昏墊之患。
context.literal: Moreover flood and drought are misfortunes Yao and Tang did not escape; a king ought to dredge and maintain canals and ditches, follow the irrigation methods of Zheng Bai, Ximen, and Shi Qi; in drought open ditches as rain, in flood send water into channels; above no worry like the "Cloudy Han," below no trouble of mire and flood.
context.idiomatic: Flood and drought, which Yao and Tang did not escape, require dredged canals and irrigation like Zheng Bai, Ximen, and Shi Qi; drought is eased by channels and flood by drainage, ending worry above and mire below.

context.zh: 句麗、百濟及宇文、段部之人，皆兵勢所徙，非如中國慕義而至，咸有思歸之心。
context.literal: The people of Goguryeo, Baekje, and the Yuwen and Duan tribes were all moved by military force, not like those of China who came admiring righteousness; all have hearts that long to return.
context.idiomatic: Goguryeo, Baekje, Yuwen, and Duan peoples were moved by force, not like Chinese who came admiring righteousness; all long to return home.

context.zh: 王憲、劉明，忠臣也，願宥忤鱗之愆，收其藥石之效。
context.literal: Wang Xian and Liu Ming are loyal ministers; I wish their offense of ruffling scales pardoned and the effect of their medicine-stone counsel gathered.
context.idiomatic: Wang Xian and Liu Ming are loyal ministers; pardon their bluntness and gather the benefit of their medicine-stone counsel.

context.zh: 皝乃令曰：「覽封記室之諫，孤實懼焉。
context.literal: Huang thereupon ordered, saying: “Having read Secretary Feng’s remonstrance, I truly fear it.
context.idiomatic: Huang issued an edict: “Feng Yu’s words frighten me.

context.zh: 君以黎元為國，黎元以穀為命。
context.literal: The lord takes the black-haired people as the state; the black-haired people take grain as life.
context.idiomatic: The ruler exists for his people; the people live on grain.

context.zh: 溝洫溉灌，有益官私，主者量造，務盡水陸之勢。
context.literal: Ditches and channels irrigation pour, benefit public and private; let the responsible officials measure and build, exhaust the advantage of water and land.
context.idiomatic: Dig irrigation works for public and private good—let engineers plan every channel.

context.zh: 中州未平，兵難不息，勳誠既多，官僚不可以減也。
context.literal: The central plain is not yet pacified; military difficulty does not cease; merit and loyalty are already many—bureaucracy cannot be reduced.
context.idiomatic: The heartland is still at war, so I cannot yet cut official posts.

context.zh: 待克平凶醜，徐更議之。
context.literal: Wait until we crush the villains, slowly again deliberate it.
context.idiomatic: We will revisit staff cuts after victory.

context.zh: 學生不任訓教者，亦除員錄。
context.literal: Students who do not bear training and teaching, also remove from rolls.
context.idiomatic: Strike idle students from the rolls.

context.zh: 夫人臣關言於人主，至難也，妖妄不經之事皆應蕩然不問，擇其善者而從之。
context.literal: As for minister’s presenting words to the lord sovereign—most difficult; demonic and wild not-classic matters all ought to be swept away unasked; choose the good of them and follow them.
context.idiomatic: Ministers who speak truth deserve patience—ignore wild rumors but heed good counsel.

context.zh: 王憲、劉明雖其罪應禁黜，亦猶孤之無大量也。
context.literal: Wang Xian and Liu Ming although their crimes ought to be banned and dismissed, also is my lacking great measure.
context.idiomatic: Wang Xian and Liu Ming, although their offenses would warrant ban and dismissal, also show my own lack of forbearance.

context.zh: 可悉復本官，仍居諫司。
context.literal: Can all restore original offices, still dwell in remonstrance offices.
context.idiomatic: Restore censured advisers to their posts.

context.zh: 封生蹇蹇，深得王臣之體。
context.literal: Feng Sheng staunchly upright, deeply attained the body of a royal minister.
context.idiomatic: Feng Yu spoke as a true minister should.

context.zh: 《詩》不云乎：'無言不酬。
context.literal: The Odes does it not say: “No word without answer.”
context.idiomatic: As the Odes says, “No good word goes unanswered.”

context.zh: '其賜錢五萬，明宣內外，有欲陳孤過者，不拘貴賤，勿有所諱。」
context.literal: Grant cash fifty thousand; clearly proclaim inside and outside: whoever wishes to state my faults, not constrained noble or base, do not have what is taboo.”
context.idiomatic: Award him fifty thousand cash and invite anyone, high or low, to criticize me freely.”

context.zh: 時有黑龍、白龍各一，見於龍山，皝親率群僚觀之，去龍二百餘步，祭乙太宰。
context.literal: At the time there were black dragon and white dragon each one, appeared at Long Mountain; Huang personally led the group of officials to observe them, two hundred-odd steps from the dragons, sacrificed with the grand boar offering.
context.idiomatic: A black dragon and a white dragon appeared on Long Mountain; Huang led his court within two hundred paces and offered the great sacrifice.

context.zh: 二龍交首嬉翔，解角而去。
context.literal: The two dragons crossed heads, sported and soared, shed horns and departed.
context.idiomatic: The beasts intertwined, sported in the air, dropped their horns, and flew away.

context.zh: 皝大悅，還宮，赦其境內，號新宮曰和龍，立龍翔佛寺於山上。
context.literal: Huang greatly pleased, returned palace, pardoned those within his borders, styled the new palace Helong, established Dragon-Soar Buddha temple on the mountain.
context.idiomatic: Elated, he returned, proclaimed an amnesty, renamed the palace Helong, and built a Buddhist monastery on the height.

context.zh: 賜其大臣子弟為官學生者號高門生，立東庠于舊宮，以行鄉射之禮，每月臨觀，考試優劣。
context.literal: Granted his great ministers’ sons and younger brothers who were official students the title “high-gate students,” set up the eastern school in the old palace, to perform the village archery rite, each month personally observing, examining excellence and inferiority.
context.idiomatic: He labeled elite students “high-gate pupils,” reopened the eastern school for archery rites, and each month examined their progress.

context.zh: 皝雅好文籍，勤于講授，學徒甚盛，至千餘人。
context.literal: Huang by nature loved documents and records, diligent in lecturing and teaching; students were extremely many, reaching over a thousand persons.
context.idiomatic: He loved books, lectured tirelessly, and kept more than a thousand students.

context.zh: 親造《太上章》以代《急就》，又著《典誡》十五篇，以教胄子。
context.literal: Personally composed the “Supreme Lord Chapter” to replace the “Rush to Literacy,” also wrote fifteen pieces of “Classic Admonitions,” to teach the sons of the house.
context.idiomatic: He wrote a primer to replace the Rush to Literacy and fifteen moral essays for the royal sons.

context.zh: 慕容恪攻高句麗南蘇，克之，置戍而還。
context.literal: Murong Ke attacked Goguryeo’s Nansu, took it, set garrison and returned.
context.idiomatic: Murong Ke seized Nansu from Goguryeo and left a garrison.

context.zh: 三年，遣其世子俊與恪率騎萬七千東襲夫餘，克之，虜其王及部眾五萬餘口以還。
context.literal: In the third year, sent his heir apparent Jun with Ke leading cavalry seventeen thousand east to raid Puyu, took it, captured their king and division host over fifty thousand mouths and returned.
context.idiomatic: In his third regnal year he sent Murong Jun and Murong Ke with seventeen thousand horse against Puyu; they captured the king and fifty thousand subjects.

context.zh: 皝親臨東庠考試學生，其經通秀異者，擢充近侍。
context.literal: Huang personally arrived at the eastern school to examine students; those whose classics were thorough and outstanding, promoted to fill close attendance.
context.idiomatic: He tested students at the eastern school and promoted the best as attendants.

context.zh: 天慈曲湣，不肆之市朝，今日之死，翰之生也。
context.literal: Heaven’s kindness bent pity, did not display me in the marketplace; today’s death is Han’s life.
context.idiomatic: The king spared me a public execution—this death is mercy.

context.zh: 但逆胡跨據神州，中原未靖，翰常克心自誓，志吞醜虜，上成先王遺旨，下謝山海之責。
context.literal: But the rebellious Hu stride occupying the divine continent; the central plain is not yet quieted; Han constantly set heart to swear, intent to swallow the ugly bandits, above to complete the late king’s leftover command, below to apologize for the duty to mountains and seas.
context.idiomatic: Yet the Hu still hold the Central Plain; I had hoped to cleanse them for Murong Hui’s sake.

context.zh: 不圖此心不遂，沒有餘恨，命也奈何！」
context.literal: Did not expect this heart not to succeed; dying there is surplus regret—fate it—what to do!”
context.idiomatic: That hope dies with me—such is fate.”
